title: Defining a Technique for the Use of Cryogenic Catheters for Biopsy and Ablation for the Diagnostic and Treatment of Pulmonary Lesions: An Ex-Vivo Human Lung Model Study.
official: Defining a Technique for the Use of Cryogenic Catheters for Biopsy and Ablation for the Diagnostic and Treatment of Pulmonary Lesions: An Ex-Vivo Human Lung Model Study.
summary: Developing a standardized methodology for the use of novel cryogenic catheters for transbronchial cryobiopsy and cryoablation of pulmonary lesions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing lung transplant surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Organ donor ineligible to donate lungs
* Healthy individuals
sponsor: Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)
